text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's New Year's, and the top star makes her entrance, boldly pushing past the festive decorations.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hark, Trainer! A heretofore unseen year is upon us.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: My beauty must have drawn it forth like a magnet. Ah, where are my manners? Happy New Overlord!
choice_data_list: Do you want some New Year's mochi?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Mochi! How timely—I graciously accept.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After we finish eating…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Last year marked my debut, and accordingly from there, a host of other achievements.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: However, the world is yet distracted with racers of the generation before mine.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Grass composed a poem, they whisper. "Sky frolicked with a cat," they murmur…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: But this year, I, too, shall run in the Classics. Therefore, once spring has passed, I can challenge them directly.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Once this new star surpasses them and becomes a soloist, the cast list will be turned on its head.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Heheh! Trainer, let us make this the year the torch is passed to me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For all her newfound braggadocio, her goals haven't changed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's my job to turn T.M. Opera O into the ultimate Centurial Overlord, so there's no avoiding the more experienced runners if we're going to succeed.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The previous generation are all very skilled. It may come back to hurt me if my preparations are anything less than stupendous.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I must act now if I'm to take the torch this year. But my actions must be grand in scale, something overlordly.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: That is why I turn to you, Trainer, o brilliant beautician of mine!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I need something befitting the Overlord! What is it? Speak and I will eagerly follow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Something overlordly… What should it be?
choice_data_list: Being reborn more powerful in a parallel universe.
A soothing rose bath atop a storied castle.
Broadening our perspective by listening to public opinion.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Reincarnation in another world! Yes, that does have an "Overlord" ring to it, though I am not sure why.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: This is my first time, but I shall attempt to visualize the events. A top tier opera star is caught up in an accident and transported to a completely different world!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oooh! Where am I? Who am I? Have I… been sent to an unknown realm?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: This power swelling from within me… Yes! I have been reborn as… the Overlord!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hmm, since I was the Overlord in my past life, to be the Overlord again doesn't make for much of a change…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: No, that matters not! My outlook is as fresh as the scenery! Haaah ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although there was no real, dramatic change from Opera O's reincarnation, I can tell her power has increased just a little.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ohh, yes! Bathing atop a castle's high tower! That is a New Year's activity befitting the Overlord if I've ever heard one!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Make it so—to the stage above the clouds!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha! Looking down at the land below from a rose bath on high, what could be more soothing?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Just look at the mountains of plastic bags stacked up around the academy! What garbage!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Opera O thoroughly enjoys the bath and seems completely refreshed.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Public opinion? Interesting… Stylishly lending my ear to their voices is yet another form of beauty, after all.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: A wonderful suggestion. We should prepare the stage now! I'll call the event, "New Year, New Me! Life Wisdom from the Top Opera Star"!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Um, Opera O? I'm thinking about becoming a stage actor, but I just don't know if it's right for me…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: A stage actor is not something you become. It becomes you.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Thinking is wholly unnecessary! People will flock to those who naturally exude the aura of a star!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Hey, Opera O! I didn't get enough New Year's money!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Then dance, sing, and write autographs at your next family gathering!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Money will come flying to you, no doubt! A flair for the dramatic can make anything come true!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She draws her answers out of thin air, yet each time, they surprisingly hit the mark. Hearing from all these people seems to have expanded her horizons.
